name: Mousam
summary: Weather at a glance: current conditions, air quality, hourly and 7-day forecasts in a GTK4 app
description: Mousam is a libadwaita weather app. It shows temperature, humidity, wind, UV index, pressure and air quality with health classifications, hourly and seven-day forecasts with charts, sun and moon tracking, dynamic backgrounds that follow the conditions, optional notifications and a compact mode. Metric and imperial units are supported.
